headline: EPS swings to a loss both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: TEMONA reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥-0.70, swinging from a ¥0.89 per-share profit last quarter and down from ¥2.62 a year ago.
summary_long: EPS of ¥-0.70 marks a swing to a loss, down from ¥0.89 in the prior quarter and ¥2.62 a year earlier. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
